Kris: quick flag — noticed invoice preview events missing route_id for a handful of tenants after the preview-key-change canary.
Marta: which canary?
Kris: preview-key-unify -> group B. example preview payload from consumer logs: {"tenant":"orbit", "route_id": null, "tokens": 90}
Devon: likely culprit: partition key switched to `session_hash` for preview topics while invoices still use `tenant+session`. post-agg enrichment join mismatches.
ingest-bot: consumer-preview-x detected partition-key metadata change at 2026-03-23T11:02:10Z
Kris: pausing canary now.
deploy-bot: canary group B paused for preview-key-unify at 11:05 UTC
Devon: mitigation: run idempotent replay of preview-shadow for affected shards, validate preview vs invoice route_id parity, then resume or rollback.
Marta: starting replay: `./shadow_replay --topic=preview-shadow --shards=300-305 --from=2026-03-23T10:40:00Z --idemp=true`
ingest-bot: replay job 3344 started, ETA ~3m
Devon: replay finished; null-route previews dropped from 67 -> 2. those 2 look like old tombstones.
Kris: followups: 1) rollout gate to block partition-key changes unless `shadow-compat=true`; 2) console alert when preview/invoice route_id mismatch > 0.5% over 10m; 3) add e2e that emits a fanout session and validates route attr across both keys.
Marta: filing ticket "preview-shadow-key-gate" and assigning to Devon/Kris.
Kris: marking incident mitigated for now. :white_check_mark:
